read.thesis: Viatris raised 2026 guidance midpoints on Greater China (+16%) and cost savings, but Nashik supply disruption cuts H2 revenue by $100-150M and China hospital policy is a looming H2 headwind.

triggers.label: 2026 midpoints raised on revenue, EBITDA, EPS
triggers.quote: we're raising the midpoint of our 2026 financial guidance ranges across all key financial metrics.

triggers.label: Nashik H2 revenue hit $100-150M
triggers.quote: We currently anticipate the impact of supply disruptions to be between $100 million and $150 million to total revenues in the second half of 2026.

triggers.label: Estradiol patch demand; ~70% orders filled
triggers.quote: We're currently, as a data point, being able to fulfill about 70% of orders.

triggers.label: China hospital procurement policy headwind
triggers.quote: Moderation in Greater China growth due to the implementation of a procurement policy change expected to negatively impact volumes in our hospital channel
